description: First of two decommissioned Jordanian armed forces Bell AH-1F Cobra attack helicopters deliberately sunk in 2019 by the Aqaba Special Economic Zone Authority as part of the Underwater Military Museum, a formation of 21 machines arranged over about 140 m of seabed. The two Cobras lie at the deep end of the site at 25 to 28 m. No serials are published for either airframe and the two cannot be distinguished in any available source.

Second of the two Bell AH-1F Cobras sunk in 2019 at the Aqaba Underwater Military Museum, lying at 25 to 28 m alongside M42 Duster, Ferret, Scorpion, Spartan, Chieftain and Ratel vehicles. Decommissioned from Jordanian service by 2000. No serial is published; this row exists so that the pair is counted correctly rather than because the individual airframe can be identified.
